title: Authorized Visitor & Personnel Entry
section: Section 1: Site Access, Identification & Entry Protocols
summary: Mandatory display of active ID badge or visitor pass on upper torso at all times upon entering site.

title: Delivery Gate Logistics Check
section: Section 1: Site Access, Identification & Entry Protocols
summary: All delivery vehicles must be logged with license plate, driver identity, arrival time, and consignment notes.

title: Head Protection (Safety Helmet Mandate)
summary: Mandatory approved safety helmet for every person in active operational zones, warehouse floors, and loading docks. Critical violation.

title: High-Visibility Clothing
summary: Personnel in areas with vehicle or forklift traffic must wear EN ISO 20471 Class 2 compliant high-vis vests.

title: Safety Footwear
summary: Steel-toe or composite protective shoes with slip-resistant soles required in storage and transit areas. Open-toe prohibited.

title: Fire Extinguisher Accessibility & Inspection Tagging
section: Section 3: Fire Safety, Emergency Equipment & Signage
summary: Radial clearance of at least 1.0 meter around fire extinguishers must be maintained. Valid inspection tag within 365 days required.

title: Emergency Exit Signage & Illuminated Path Indicators
section: Section 3: Fire Safety, Emergency Equipment & Signage
summary: Illuminated green/white exit signs conforming to ISO 7010 required over all exit doors and escape routes 24/7.

title: Primary Walkway Minimum Clearance
section: Section 4: Walkways, Transit Corridors & Emergency Exits
summary: Primary pedestrian transit walkways must maintain a continuous minimum unobstructed clearance width of 1.2 meters.

title: Emergency Fire Exit Zero-Tolerance Clearance
section: Section 4: Walkways, Transit Corridors & Emergency Exits
summary: Designated emergency exit doors and routes must be 100% unobstructed. Storing pallets, boxes, or debris within 2.0m is strictly prohibited.

title: Pallet Stacking Height Limits
section: Section 5: Pallet Stacking, Storage & Racking Integrity
summary: Pallet stacks must not exceed 2.4 meters or 3 units high. Must be uniformly shrink-wrapped with no lean exceeding 5 degrees.

title: Racking Upright Protection & Overhang
section: Section 5: Pallet Stacking, Storage & Racking Integrity
summary: Merchandise on racking must not overhang into transit aisles by more than 50 mm (2 inches). Must adhere to certified beam load limits.

title: Immediate Spill Containment
section: Section 6: Spill Control, Liquid Hazards & Housekeeping
summary: Liquid spills exceeding 0.5L must be cordoned off with caution cones within 15 minutes and neutralized using spill kits.

title: Consignment Delivery Note Matching
section: Section 7: Delivery Documentation, Permits & Ingestion Compliance
summary: Inbound deliveries must match delivery note line items, vendor name, PO reference, and receiver signature. Extractions below 0.85 confidence route to human review.

title: Remediation Ticket Generation & Approval Gate
section: Section 8: Automated Compliance Ticketing & Human Approval Gate
summary: Agent proposes remediation tickets for High/Critical failures. Tickets remain in proposed status until explicitly approved by an authorized manager in the UI.
